Graceful shutdown stops accepting new connections, drains in-flight work, closes DB and exits with
deadline on SIGTERM.
Shutdown signal එකක් ආවම new requests accept කිරීම නවතා active work finish කරන්න ඉඩ Jදන්න.
Deadline එකක් සහ DB close එකක් තියන්න.
SIGTERM Stop accepting connections Drain active requests Close DB · exit
Read the diagram: Bound shutdown time and handle lingering sockets appropriately.
Expected result: Server tries graceful drain and DB close before deadline.

Interview question: Why avoid immediate process.exit on deployment?
Answer: It may interrupt in-flight requests and writes.
Practice: Design readiness behavior during shutdown.
